path.description: Sends the node whose line is read: the leaf chosen, or any place above it. The line is the node, every kind it is, what sits beneath it and every place above it.

q.description: Sends the terms to grep, as the buyer or a shop says them; a "quoted phrase" is one term. A passage holding every term comes first, then one holding some.

document.description: Reads one document's passages in order instead of grepping: any `id` a passage or a domain's map carried, from part `from` on; past its last part, none.

from.description: Starts the read of `document` at this part. Default 1.

kinds.description: Narrows the read to these kinds of document; absent reads every kind.

min_passages.description: Fills up to this many from the nearest documents when too few match, marked by an empty `matched`. Default 1.

max_tokens.description: Caps what the passages cost, a token being four characters of a passage as sent; the last passage is cut to fit and marked `truncated`. Default 2000.
